drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 60-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.72, creatinine 2.07, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 318, sodium 139, wbc 8.3; vitals dbp 63-68, heart_rate 84-86, map 81-86, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 116-121, spo2 93-95, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Normal saline 1 L IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. COPD. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. No acute blood loss anemia; mild drop is dilutional.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.04, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 316, sodium 139, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 63-68, heart_rate 81-86, map 80-85, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 115-122, spo2 94-95, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. COPD. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. No acute blood loss anemia; mild drop is dilutional. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 60-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. COPD. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. No acute blood loss anemia; mild drop is dilutional. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
